errors.apple-music-authorization-lost: Apple did not accept the authorization. Connect again.
errors.apple-music-developer-token-refus: Apple refused this server's credentials. The server's Apple Developer settings need checking.

errors.forbidden: You can view this library but not change it.
errors.invalid-external-id: That identifier does not have the form its system uses.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.
errors.rate-limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.sign-in-rejected: That email and password were not recognized.
errors.sync-already-running: A read from Apple Music is already running for this library.
errors.sync-not-running: That read from Apple Music has already finished.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
